definitions.explanation: The collective term for items used for sleeping, including futons, blankets, pillows, sheets, and mattresses.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{寝具|しんぐ}を{買|か}いに{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to buy new bedding.

examples.japanese: {良質|りょうしつ}な{寝具|しんぐ}を{使|つか}うと{睡眠|すいみん}の{質|しつ}が{上|あ}がると{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It is said that using quality bedding improves the quality of sleep.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
{寝|しん} (sleep) + {具|ぐ} (tool, equipment).

USAGE:
{寝具|しんぐ} is a general category term that encompasses all sleeping-related items. It is used in shopping, hotel, and household contexts. More specific terms include:
- {布団|ふとん}: futon (mattress and/or comforter)
- {枕|まくら}: pillow
- シーツ: sheets
- {毛布|もうふ}: blanket

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寝具|しんぐ}を{整|ととの}える: to arrange the bedding
- {寝具|しんぐ}を{干|ほ}す: to air out bedding
- {寝具|しんぐ}メーカー: bedding manufacturer
- {寝具|しんぐ}{売|う}り{場|ば}: bedding section (of a store)
